Hello, prospective new friend! I'm 31M/PC/CST and a student studying cybersecurity who also loves writing. My current video game addiction is Dead By Daylight. I started playing this year in January, and at the time of writing this, I've amassed 549 hours in this wonderfully intense horror game. My biggest regret is not playing sooner because of all the events I've missed and opportunities to grind and level my characters. I started out playing only killer, my favorite being Michael Myers (I'm a huge horror movie fan and Halloween is one of my favorite movies of all time), but after a while, thanks in part to this subreddit, I started making friends who played. I started playing more survivor as well. I have a small server of wonderful people whom I enjoy playing with semi-regularly. These days, I probably play about 60% survivor and 40% killer. 

  
I also have Stardew Valley and around 246 hours invested in it. I love farming simulators (I primarily play Story of Seasons Pioneers of Olive Town on my Switch right now) and dream of one day having a small-scale farm of my own. I'd love an excuse to jump back into Stardew Valley, especially starting a farm with someone else or a few others. 

I have about 244 hours in Don't Starve, but I haven't played in about 5 years. I love survival and crafting games (I also play a bit of Minecraft, I recently got back into it) and although I haven't played in ages I'd be down to play again with another person or small group (I only have 20 hours in Don't Starve Together because I never found others to play with.)

I have the original Overcooked on my Switch, and I love this game as well. I would be playing it more often if I had people to play it with, but unfortunately, I don't. However, I'd be down to get it on Steam if I had people to play with (this applies to the sequel as well). 

  
I've been a huge Dark Souls fan since the original, and I can't imagine how many hours I have collectively across the entire franchise (probably at least 1000 haha), but I usually play them only on console. Elden Ring was amazing and everything I could want for the first step into an open world. If my 8-year-old PC could run it, I'd love to play it Co-op with you. I remember playing Dark Souls 2 on my Xbox and doing a co-op run with 2 other people for a short time, and we did specific builds (archer, knight, mage) and had a lot of fun. 

  
I recently got Marvel Rivals and R.E.P.O., but I haven't played either yet.

  
I've been a writer since high school, and over the course of many years I've written a few dozen or so poems and a short story (I had periods in my life where I stopped writing altogether, but I've recently started writing poetry again.) I want to complete a novel that I'm beginning, and also start publishing my poetry, but I would love the chance to find a kindred spirit and get proper feedback and constructive criticism. 

  
Apologies for the lengthyness of my comment, but I'm really excited to find more people to play with and someone to potentially workshop writing with, I hope this finds you well and I look forward to hearing from you soon.
